sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We value our long relationship and understand that rising wage and metal costs put pressure on your family-run foundry and skilled team. Our order volume is fixed and represents our full demand for this part over the term, all with you; in return, we offer a long contract term to support your planning security. Would this arrangement help you reconsider the proposed price adjustment?

We confirm a binding volume of 4000 units a year for the 24-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is on file (cost:part:PH-100).
Your letter (doc:D01-LETTER) gives less notice than our agreement provides for (ctr:D01-FRAMEWORK).
We compared your offer with our recent order prices for this part (po:4500001201, po:4500001288, po:4500001342).

On this basis we propose: EUR 48.88 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, valid from 2026-12-01, for our full demand of 4000 units a year over 24 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €50.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We value our long-standing relationship and appreciate your commitment to a 24-month contract for the full volume of 4000 units.
We have carefully considered your points regarding the notice period and price history, and have factored them into our revised calculation.
We are pleased to accept the 24-month term and offer a reduced price of EUR 50.40, but in trade we must maintain our standard 30-day payment terms.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €50.00 per unit.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
Thank you for taking our points into account and for moving your offer toward us; we appreciate your flexibility and our long-standing relationship. We understand that your pricing reflects your costs, and hope the fixed full-demand volume and long contract term provide useful planning security. We have moved toward you again in our proposal, which follows below.

We have reviewed your delivery performance in our supplier scorecard (sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 49.05 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2026-12-01, for our full demand of 4000 units a year over 24 months.

Kind regards,
